prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Generous margins, phone-legible text. No watermark, logo, app chrome, contact sheet, or unsupplied paragraphs. Sound/spelling associations are memory aids, never pronunciation or etymological claims.
Header text verbatim: "slappna av". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "relax".
Scene: An adult woman leaning back comfortably on a sofa after work, shoes set aside and shoulders relaxed, warm calm light.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "slappna av = relax; let the tension go.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Hon slappnar av i soffan.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established card style described in the prompt; no image supplied.
